title: PredictionEvent
description: One scored event exported by a prediction service. Sibling repositories can emit this shape so the same monitoring checks apply to them.

event_id.description: Unique identifier of the scored event.

timestamp.description: When the input was received (event time), ISO 8601 with timezone.

features.description: Feature name to value. Values may be number, string, boolean or null. The key set is the schema being monitored.

score.description: Model output used for the decision.

decision.description: Categorical decision taken from the score.

route.description: Where the event went next (auto, queue name, review desk).

label.description: Ground truth when known; null until it arrives.

label_available_at.description: When the label became (or will become) known; null when no label exists yet.

scored_at.description: Optional. When the score was produced. Inference latency is scored_at minus timestamp; latency statistics are null when this field is absent.
